# Muster

> Muster is a grassroots advocacy platform enabling nonprofits, associations, agencies, and companies to mobilize stakeholders and drive policy impact through integrated campaign management, CRM, and communications tools.

Muster provides comprehensive advocacy software solutions designed for organizations engaged in public policy, government relations, and stakeholder engagement. The platform integrates advocacy CRM, campaign management, email and SMS broadcasts, and impact reporting to help organizations measure and amplify their advocacy efforts.

## Key Topics

- Grassroots Advocacy
- Advocacy CRM
- Campaign Management
- Government Relations
- Member Engagement
- Policy Advocacy
- Public Policy
- Advocacy Campaigns
- Analytics & Reporting

## Core Platform

- [Muster | Grassroots Advocacy Software](https://www.muster.com/home): Muster grassroots advocacy platform for nonprofits engaging in public policy.
- [Muster | Grassroots Advocacy Platform](https://www.muster.com/product): Main product overview showcasing Muster's advocacy platform capabilities.
- [Muster Advocacy CRM](https://www.muster.com/product/advocacycrm): Advocacy CRM stakeholder management tool for government relations professionals.
- [Advocacy Campaigns](https://www.muster.com/product/advocacy-campaigns): Campaign software for policy and regulatory advocacy engagement.
- [Muster | About Us](https://www.muster.com/about): Muster company mission and background in grassroots advocacy solutions.

## Engagement & Communications

- [Muster | Email Broadcasts](https://www.muster.com/product/email-broadcasts): Email broadcast feature for advocate engagement and action alerts.
- [Muster | Text Broadcasts](https://www.muster.com/product/text-broadcasts): SMS text messaging for mobile-friendly grassroots advocacy campaigns.
- [Muster | District Impact Reports | Products](https://www.muster.com/product/impact-reporting): District impact reports transforming advocacy data into stakeholder stories.

## Solutions by Organization Type

- [Muster For Nonprofit Organizations](https://www.muster.com/solutions/nonprofits): Nonprofit advocacy software for grassroots political campaign engagement.
- [Muster For Associations](https://www.muster.com/solutions/associations): Association advocacy platform for member engagement and policy wins.
- [Muster | Advocacy and Government Relations Software for Agencies](https://www.muster.com/solutions/agencies): Government relations software delivering advocacy results for agencies.
- [Muster For Chambers of Commerce](https://www.muster.com/solutions/chamber-of-commerce): Chamber of commerce advocacy tools for member engagement and policy.
- [Muster | Solutions For Companies](https://www.muster.com/solutions/companies): Corporate advocacy platform for stakeholder management and impact.
